We are looking for an experienced Bricklayer to join our growing construction team working on residential, commercial and refurbishment projects across the Isle of Man. The successful candidate will be responsible for carrying out all aspects of bricklaying and masonry work, including blockwork, facing brickwork, foundations, retaining walls, structural alterations and general construction activities. Applicants should be capable of working independently and as part of a team, with a strong focus on quality workmanship, productivity and site safety. Experience in new-build, refurbishment and extension projects would be advantageous. Trade qualifications would be beneficial but are not essential for candidates who can demonstrate relevant experience and a high standard of work. A valid driving licence would be advantageous. To apply, please send a CV detailing your experience and qualifications to info@newearth.build

Our client, an Isle of Man fiduciary business, is seeking an experienced Head of Compliance on a six-month contract. The role involves leading the compliance function, owning the compliance monitoring programme, maintaining and reviewing policies and procedures, and ensuring the business continues to meet its obligations under the Island’s regulatory framework and the AML/CFT Code. You will report to the board on compliance matters, prepare and submit regulatory returns, act as a point of contact for the regulator, and oversee customer due diligence, business and customer risk assessments, and periodic file reviews. You will also advise the wider business on regulatory and financial crime matters, deliver compliance training, and support any remediation or project work required during the contract term. Significant compliance experience within a trust and corporate service provider is essential, along with a thorough working knowledge of Isle of Man regulatory requirements and the confidence to operate at board level from day one. A relevant professional qualification such as ICA Dip is also essential. This is a contract position and would suit an experienced compliance professional available at short notice. Notes

We're Hiring!
Front of House Team Member.
South of the Island - Please note that you must have your own transport for our remote location.

vacancies@bdc.im

Are you a friendly, energetic people-person who loves great coffee, good food and even better company? Our cafe in the south of the island is on the lookout for a warm, reliable Front of House team member to join our small, close-knit crew. If you take pride in looking after guests and keeping a busy cafe running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.
The Role
Position: Front of House (FOH).
Hours: 25-40 hours per week (across weekdays and weekends).
Pay: Minimum wage.
Location: South of the island.
Own transport: Essential.
What You'll Be Doing
As part of our Front of House team, your day-to-day will include:
Opening and closing of the cafe.
Greet, assist and seat guests.
Take customer orders efficiently and accurately and communicate orders to Back of House (BOH).
Provide a good level of customer service (including preparation of beverages and food).
Maintaining order within the cafe and adhere to required standards.
Setting of tables and assisting BOH with delivery of meals.
Co-ordination between FOH and BOH to maintain timely service.
Clearing of tables during service and cleaning of tables and surrounds post service.
Ensuring the outside deck, cafe, bar area and bathrooms are kept clean and maintained at appropriate hygiene standards and a professional image is always portrayed.
Ordering of beverage and snack stock from suppliers.
Inventory management – replenishment of beverages, snacks and condiments, including stock rotation.
Filing of delivery notes and invoices.
Monthly stocktaking of all FOH items.
Accurate recording of transactions and end of day cash-up and safe keeping of monies.
Replying to emails and telephonic bookings if required.
Receiving and accumulating general customer feedback.
Preparation of staff rosters and work scheduling.
Always maintain a professional appearance.
Performing any reasonable ad-hoc tasks requested by the Manager / Owners.
About You
Previous hospitality or cafe experience preferred.
Own reliable transport is essential.
Warm, friendly and customer-focused.
Reliable, punctual and well-presented.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and as part of a team.
Good communication skills and a positive attitude.
Able to work flexible shifts, including weekends.
What We Offer
A warm, supportive team and a relaxed island work environment.
Stable hours (30-40 per week) with a regular roster.
The chance to grow your hospitality skills in a busy, well-loved cafe.
How to Apply
If this sounds like you, we'd love to meet you. Please email your CV and a short note about yourself to vacancies@bdc.im 

We can't wait to welcome the right person to the team!

Notes
Homefire Group, a part of Invica Industries, is the UK's leading smokeless fuel and kiln dried firewood manufacturer and supplier, putting sustainable warmth and comfort at the heart of your home. We’ve been keeping homes warm and cosy for nearly 300 years. We operate from over 40 locations in England, Wales and Scotland, including the Isle of Man and the Isle of Wight. Additionally, Homefire Group is Europe's leading manufacturer of smokeless solid fuels.

We have a range of market favourite brands and a strong commitment to new product development, leading the industry in technical advances and growing our consumer base. We are on a journey to cleaner and greener products, and by buying our Homefire range, our customers can be assured that they are receiving great quality fuel every single time.

Working within Homefire Group, an exciting opportunity has arisen for a professional driver to join our Isle of Man Depot on a full-time permanent basis, delivering a high-quality delivery service for fuel related products to retail and commercial customers. You will be delivering a range of products, from a small bag of kindling to our 25kg briquettes or even products from our summer garden range such as bark bales. Whilst there is a large amount of manual handling, we do provide tools to aid deliveries such as sack trolleys.

During the busier winter months, we do require drivers to work alternative Saturdays and overtime during the week where required to ensure we can fulfil the needs of our customers.

The successful candidate will have:

An enthusiastic and hard working attitude, ideally with previous experience within a similar role and working to delivery lead times.

C1 Licence required.

Driver CPC.

Knowledge of Digital Tachograph Cards.

Good knowledge and ability to work in accordance with transport legislation, and health and safety procedures.

Strong customer service skills, with a professional and personable approach to both retail and commercial customers.

Good knowledge of local traffic and road systems.

What we offer:

£13.00hour

40 hour/week contracts

Overtime during the busier months (generally October – March)

Weekly tonnage bonus

Annual driver performance bonus

Company Paid Health Cash Plan

24/7 Access to a UK GP

Employee Assistance Program including access to “My Health Advantage”

Access to a reward programme, providing access to discounts across hundreds of retailers

Driver CPC renewal

Provision of uniform

If you want to join us in fuelling the future, please submit your CV and/or covering letter to recruitment@invicaindustries.com. We plan to commence interviews from week commencing 9th November 2026.

Immediate start.

Delivering your part of our customer shopping trip by:

I ensurethe van and trays I use are clean and kept tidy/organised.
Leaving the back yard clean, tidy and clear of rubbish, and picking up litter as I see it.
Ensuring trays are washed as part of the tray wash process.
Loading the van as required, checking the van for roadworthiness.
Talking to the customer about any changes to their order, including short code item and substitutions, offering a refund for anything they are unhappy with.
Taking care of products/deliveries as if they were my own.
Explaining to the customer that they will not be charged any more for their substitutions.
Delivering during the customers time slot.
Calling the customer before arriving at their property if early.
Calling the store/centre if running 30 or more minutes late.
You will need
Build relationships with colleagues to create team spirit, working together to make sure our store is the best it can be for customers.
Warm and welcoming in interactions with customers and colleagues, taking time to understand the customer and say Thank you.
Acting quickly to respond to the changing needs of our customers and embracing change within my store.
Energetic and driven to deliver beyond expectations, integrating home and work to achieve a balance that is right for me.
Sharing ideas with my Manager and other colleagues on how we can improve our store for customers.
A valid UK/EU/EEA Driving licence (Full or Automatic only) for at least 12 months with no more than 3 penalty points.

Notes
Have you ever thought of being a Delivery Driver? Do you love driving? Are you looking for a fun and flexible role enabling you to work within a fast paced team environment? We are looking to hire full time and part time Delivery Drivers at our Onchan store.

Being a Delivery Driver means you are the forefront of our business, you will be responsible for delivering excellent customer service at all times, ensuring all deliveries are made on time, hot and fresh. At Domino’s Pizza we provide you with excellent on the job training, you will be trained in all aspects of the role ensuring all products are delivered safely and securely as well as Food Hygiene and Safety training to ensure you maintain the highest standards of food hygiene and store cleanliness.

BENEFITS:

£13.50ph weekdays & £14.50ph at weekends
Free Uniform
Business Use Insurance - cost covered by us
GPS System
Staff Discount
Paid extra for each order delivered

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Upholding a positive brand image and providing excellent customer service at all times.
Managing transactions effectively in accordance with company procedures.
Delivering products safely and securely, avoiding unnecessary risks by adhering to all safety and security policies.
Working as part of the Domino’s delivery driver team, which includes assisting our in store team to deliver fantastic service, great food in a fun, safe and hygienic store.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS/EXPERIENCE:

Own car and full driving licence held with no more than 6 points and no bans in the last 5 years.
Own Insurance held to qualify for the company business insurance.
Good communication and hard working.
Available to work over evenings and weekends.
Good knowledge of local area.

For this role, it is essential that you have a Full Driving Licence with access to your own car, or a car you have permission to drive. You must be aged 18 minimum.
This is a fantastic opportunity to work for a growing company, known for great customer service and flexible working hours. If you like a fast paced environment where time flies and you have fun, then APPLY TODAY and we will get straight back to you to arrange a chat.

The ideal candidate for the position must be passionate about customer service, quality and driving! If you have the attitude, we have the training for you.

Submit your CV to iomdominos@gmail.com

Manx Independent Carriers are seeking a dependable, self-motivated professional to join our parcels department as a delivery driver. In this role, you will be the face of our company, responsible for the safe, efficient, and timely delivery and collection of parcels across the Isle of Man

You will be responsible for daily safety checks on your delivery van and organising parcels to optimise your route. Transporting and delivering a high volume of multi-drop packages efficiently, ensuring items are handled with care. Using handheld scanners to log real-time deliveries, capture customer signatures, and document safe-place photo proof. Providing a friendly, professional service at the doorstep and handling customer inquiries politely. 

The ideal candidate will hold a full, valid driving licence with a clean record. Good familiarity with Isle of Man geography, towns and rural routes is desirable however full training will be given to the successful candidate.

This role is responsible for carrying out and supporting the maintenance, installation, testing, commissioning, and fault investigation of power generation plant and equipment. Working independently, as part of a team, or in a leadership capacity, the post holder will undertake planned and reactive maintenance, inspect and diagnose equipment issues, maintain accurate records using maintenance management systems, and help plan and schedule maintenance activities. The position also includes preparing maintenance documentation, mentoring and supervising colleagues, participating in training and assessments, and operating company vehicles and mobile plant where qualified. The ideal candidate will be a qualified electrical craftsman with a Level 3 electrical qualification, electrical maintenance experience, strong IT and interpersonal skills, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively. A commitment to health, safety, environmental standards, continuous learning, and Manx Utilities’ values is essential, along with flexibility to work across power generation sites and a valid driving licence.

Our Client are an internationally renowned engineering business, who are enjoying continued growth across many departments. They are now seeking an ERP Data Analyst to join an established team.
The ERP Data Analyst you will become the analytical backbone of manufacturing operations. You will support ownership of developing, managing, and optimising the ERP and MRP systems, ensuring they evolve alongside the growing business needs. Beyond system maintenance, you will act as a vital bridge between raw data and real-world execution, understanding how data flows through the entire supply chain, able to translate complex metrics into clear, actionable insights.
The ideal candidate for the role of ERP Data Analyst will have experience managing, configuring, and developing ERP and/or MRP systems, ideally within a fast-paced manufacturing or engineering environment, a qualification with professional experience in Data Analytics, Business Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline, a strong understanding of core manufacturing concepts, such as Bill of Materials (BOM), inventory control, demand planning, and production scheduling, proficiency with database management, query languages (like SQL), and data visualization tools (such as Power BI, Tableau, or advanced Excel) is highly desirable.

and prove out

areas. To create CAD/CAMgenerated
methods for millturning
applications. CNC Milling programming experience

ACCOUNTABILITIES: To be the process development

applications. To carry out operator

tracking for equipment procurement. To provide cover
were required within the operational function and
participate in crossfunctional
activity. COMPETENCY: Experience of generating new
product methods is vital either via CAD/CAM or directly

sector. Shift rate and overtime rates that are also
competitive within the IOM Engineering sector. Company

Notes
Role Purpose
The Senior Administrator is responsible for delivering an accurate, efficient and customer-focused investment administration service. The role involves managing transactions and complex queries, maintaining strong operational controls, supporting colleagues and contributing to continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities
Investment Administration

Process investment transactions and customer requests accurately and within agreed service levels.

Maintain accurate investment, asset and customer records.

Liaise with fund managers, custodians, advisers and other counterparties to resolve queries and progress transactions.

Investigate complex issues, resolve outstanding transactions and escalate where necessary.

Follow established procedures, controls and regulatory requirements.

Customer and Stakeholder Management

Deliver a professional, timely and customer-focused service.

Take ownership of queries through to resolution.

Communicate clearly and work collaboratively with internal teams and external stakeholders.

Risk, Controls and Quality

Maintain high standards of accuracy and identify operational risks, errors and control weaknesses.

Complete quality checks and authorised activities where required.

Support investigations, corrective actions and accurate management reporting.

Team Support and Development

Provide technical guidance and support to colleagues.

Share knowledge, assist with training and contribute to workload planning.

Support the Team Leader or Manager with daily operations and wider team activities.

Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve processes, controls and customer outcomes.

Support system changes, testing, procedure updates and business improvement initiatives.

Person Specification
Experience and Knowledge

Experience in financial services, ideally in investments, investment operations, life assurance or administration.

Good understanding of investment administration and operational processes.

Knowledge of funds, equities and bonds is desirable.

Experience handling complex queries, liaising with external parties and supporting colleagues is advantageous.

Skills and Behavior's

Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

We are recruiting for a Group Assistant Tax Business Partner to join our client's tax team, supporting the completion of tax compliance work and the development of junior team members. The role involves managing a portfolio of trust and company clients to ensure all tax compliance and reporting obligations are completed accurately and within statutory filing deadlines. You will prepare and review group tax reporting requirements including Income Tax, Corporation Tax, Capital Gains Tax, ATED, Inheritance Tax returns, RISPG calculations and VAT, with potential to develop expertise in other areas and jurisdictions. You will review work completed by trainee and junior colleagues, providing technical guidance, coaching and constructive feedback, and assist in overseeing workflow allocation and task prioritisation within the tax team. You will also review trust and company accounts from a tax perspective to identify tax risks, monitor compliance deadlines, act as a point of reference for tax queries across the organisation, liaise with clients and professional advisers on tax matters, and support fee quotation, budgeting and billing processes. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 3 years' relevant tax experience, strong technical knowledge of UK taxation, and excellent organisational skills, attention to detail, and communication abilities. ATT, STEP or ACCA qualification is preferred, with CTA studies commenced or willingness to pursue further qualifications being desirable. Experience working with fiduciary structures, trusts and companies is preferred. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your career in a busy corporate services environment. Join us as Senior Customer Service Advisor at Barclays, to provide resolutions for customer queries/issues and personalise each interaction through the use of multiple communication channels.
To be successful as a Senior Customer Service Advisor, you should have:
Strong awareness of risk and control to support the completion of high-value transaction approvals, payment investigations and complaints where risk issues arise.
Support leadership with the delivery of service levels, change implementation, driving a culture of continuous improvement whilst supporting colleagues with complex issues and escalations.
Support embedment and upskilling of newly recruited colleagues and identify opportunities to become multi-skilled in role to support the delivery of a consistently excellent service across all channels of engagement.
Some other highly valued skills may include:
Experience leading or holding a senior role within a service centre environment.

Experience in wealth management/private banking sector dealing with high-net-worth clients.
Awareness of Consumer Duty framework including identification and management of vulnerable clients.
You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

To apply  https://barclays.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/External_Career_Site_Barclays/job/Isle-of-Man-Eagle-Court/Senior-Client-Service-Executive_JR-0000046486-1

Life cover/death in service. Private healthcare cover. Paid CPD and relevant Professional Subscriptions. Our client seeks an experienced and detail-oriented Accounts Assistant to join their team. This role focuses on maintaining accurate financial records, managing day-to-day transactions, and ensuring compliance across a group of trading companies. Reporting directly to the Accounts Manager the successful candidate will play a key role in supporting the finance function, delivering timely reconciliations, and enabling informed decision-making. Key Responsibilities: Maintain accurate financial records for three active trading companies, ensuring all entries are complete and compliant with internal policies and relevant accounting standards. Perform daily and monthly bank reconciliations, resolving discrepancies promptly. Process accounts payable and receivable, ensuring timely supplier payments and accurate client invoicing. Prepare and post journals for accruals, prepayments, and other adjustments. Manage intercompany transactions, reconciliations, and currency transfers. Support month-end and year-end close processes, including the preparation of management accounts and reports for the Financial Director. Assist with VAT and other statutory filings, liaising with external advisors as necessary. Monitor cash flow and provide forecasts to support operational planning. Maintain organised digital and physical financial documentation. Support internal and external audit requirements by providing accurate records and explanations. Key Skills and Experience: CAT qualified (or equivalent) or working towards a recognised accounting qualification, with potential support for ACCA study if desired. Proven accounting experience, ideally across multiple trading companies or group structures. Strong knowledge of accounting principles, reconciliations, and financial reporting. Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel. Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to liaise effectively across teams and with external partners. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16836

Notes
Comis Hotel & Golf Resort – Santon, Isle of Man
Department: Finance
Hours: 30 hours per week, generally Monday to Friday
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience

We are looking for an experienced and detail-focused Accounts Assistant to join our Finance team.
Reporting to the Financial Controller, you will support the day-to-day financial operations of the business, including bank reconciliations, purchase ledger, supplier payments and maintaining accurate accounting records.

Key Responsibilities:

Daily bank and system reconciliations.
Processing supplier invoices and reconciling supplier accounts.
Preparing weekly and monthly payment batches.
Investigating cash and card variances.
Maintaining control accounts and finance spreadsheets.
Preparing journals and posting accounting entries.
Ensuring financial controls and procedures are followed.

About You:

Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant, bookkeeping or similar finance role.
Strong bookkeeping and reconciliation experience.
Sound knowledge of accounting principles and VAT.
Excellent numerical skills and attention to detail.
Good Microsoft Excel skills.
Experience using accounting software; Sage Intacct would be advantageous.
Able to work independently and as part of a small team.

What We Offer:

Competitive salary.
30-hour working week, generally Monday to Friday.
Hotel discounts.
Staff meals and uniform.
Service charge participation.
Free on-site parking.
Training and development opportunities.

To apply, please send your CV to HR@comishotel.com.

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the Isle of Man or UK. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Strictly no agencies.

Notes
Step into the role as a Anti-Money Laundering Analyst on a 12-month fixed term contract at Barclays, where you will support the effective operation of the AML/CFT control environment by reviewing customer and transactional activity, investigating alerts, and identifying unusual or potentially suspicious behaviour. You will apply a risk-based approach, maintain clear and accurate case records, escalate concerns in line with internal procedures, and collaborate with Financial Crime, Compliance, and operational teams to help protect the bank and its customers from financial crime.
To be successful as a Anti-Money Laundering Analyst, you must have experience with:
Previous experience in transaction monitoring and/or financial crime operations, with the ability to identify suspicious activity, conduct effective investigations, and make informed risk-based decisions regarding escalations and case outcomes, is essential.
Considerable analytical and investigative skills are essential, including the ability to assess complex transaction patterns, identify potential financial crime risks, and conduct thorough investigations to support effective risk-based decision-making.
Excellent attention to detail is essential, with the ability to accurately review customer and transactional activity, maintain comprehensive case records, and produce clear, concise, and audit-ready investigation summaries. 
Some other highly valued skills may include:
Good AML/CFT knowledge and risk awareness, including an understanding of customer risk factors, sanctions, PEPs, and suspicious activity indicators.
Knowledge of payments, banking products, transaction flows, and common financial-crime typologies.
A practical problem-solving mindset and the ability to work collaboratively with Financial Crime, Compliance, and operational/business stakeholders.
You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills. To apply  https://barclays.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/External_Career_Site_Barclays/job/Isle-of-Man-Eagle-Court/Banking---Payments-Operations-Transaction-Monitoring-Analyst---12-month-Fixed-Term-Contract_JR-0000136457-1

Notes
Our client seeks a Head of Compliance to join their team on a part-time basis. Subject to regulatory approval, and after adequate training and familiarisation, the role holder will ultimately hold the following statutory positions: Compliance Officer, under Part 9 of the IOM Financial Services Rule Book. Ideally, Money Laundering Reporting Officer, under the IOM AML/CFT Code 2019. You must be able to satisfy the IOM FSA on competence, time commitment, accessibility and effective oversight. An initial familiarisation period may be agreed before specific statutory positions are formally transferred. Key Responsibilities: Discharge the statutory role under Part 9 of the IOM Financial Services Rule Book, acting as primary point of contact with the IOM FSA. Maintain compliance monitoring programme, regulatory returns, statutory registers, policy suite and the authorisation of new SPV structures. Oversee periodic client reviews and approve higher-risk new business across the SPV book. Ideally hold the MLRO function, receive internal reports, liaise with the IOM Financial Intelligence Unit. Run group sanctions screening (OFSI, OFAC, EU, UN), customer due diligence and transaction monitoring proportionate to the group's exposure, with particular attention to maritime risk. Deliver annual AML/CFT training to employees and report to the relevant boards on financial crime risk. Maintain the compliance requirements and risk assessment suite, AML/CFT and policy suite, and report to the Board. Key Skills and Experience: Ideally minimum three years' compliance experience in regulated financial services. Working knowledge of the IOM Financial Services Rule Book and AML/CFT Code 2019. Recognised compliance qualification such as the ICA Diploma in Compliance, the CISI Diploma in Investment Compliance or equivalent. Based in the Isle of Man. Track record of direct FSA engagement. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16832

About the role:
You will assist the Audit Manager in planning and executing audit processes, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial records. This role involves supporting the audit team, conducting audits, and helping to develop audit strategies.

Reports to: Associate Director – Audit  

Main Responsibilities:

Assist in planning, coordinating, and executing internal and external audits.
Support daily audit operations and ensure compliance with auditing standards.
Review and analyse financial statements, budgets, and forecasts.
Help ensure compliance with accounting principles, financial regulations, and company policies.
Assist in managing and mentoring the audit team.
Contribute to the development and implementation of audit strategies and procedures.
Identify and assess areas of financial risk and assist in implementing mitigation strategies.
Collaborate with external auditors and regulatory bodies.
Monitor audit findings and follow up on corrective actions.
There may be opportunities to work in other areas of the general practice and fiduciaries side of the business such as the preparation of financial statements and get involved with tax compliance such as drafting tax and VAT returns.

Essential skills:
Strong knowledge of auditing standards, accounting principles and financial reporting regulations.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
High attention to detail.

Knowledge and qualifications:
ACCA or ACA qualified or equivalent professional certification. 
Proficient in accounting software, Word, Excel and Outlook.

For more details and to apply contact epl.admin@epl.im or 01624615600.

You'll work closely with the Head of Finance, supporting management accounts production, month-end journals, variance analysis, and budgeting and forecasting across two product-focused business units. Key Responsibilities: Prepare and post month-end transaction-based journals relating to product-line activity. Support variance analysis and produce clear commentaries on management accounts and key financial information. Assist in the preparation and production of product profit and loss accounts, including monthly financial reports and ad hoc financial reporting requests. Prepare and maintain balance sheet reconciliations for relevant general ledger codes. Prepare and validate purchase requests and check accounts payable expense invoices. Coordinate and help develop internal financial reports, maintaining the internal reporting control summary and ensuring timely delivery. Assist product managers in the preparation of monthly forecasts. Interact with cross-functional teams and the wider finance function to meet monthly deadlines and resolve accounting issues. Prepare and maintain process documentation; drive improvements to existing processes and controls. Support initiatives to improve product profits and profit margins. Assist in the processing and production of billing processes. Perform special projects and other duties as assigned. Key Skills and Experience: Experience in a similar financial or accounting role. Studying finalist for ACA, ACCA or CIMA, or newly qualified / qualified by experience. Strong analytical, evaluative and problem-solving abilities. Intermediate Excel skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a close-knit team. Familiarity with IoT, roaming, managed services, data centres or connectivity sectors is advantageous. Previous experience working with Sage X3 or a similar ERP system is desirable. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16908

Notes
We are a small to medium sized accounts practice which due to continuing growth and future plans, is now recruiting for the following role in our Port Erin office.  In return for a competitive salary and benefits package, we can offer you exciting career prospects and the opportunity to develop in a professional environment as a Senior Accountant reporting directly to the company’s Accounts Manager.  We are a friendly team and provide flexibility and support to our staff to ensure we deliver the best results to our clients. 

The successful candidate for this role should ideally have some audit experience or will be looking to develop that skillset in order to manage a small but growing portfolio of Isle of Man audit clients. 
 
Diligence, and strong organisational skills are a necessity and you must have a minimum of 3 years’ post qualification experience at a relatively senior level, preferably in an Isle of Man and/or UK accounts practice.  You must be confident and have strong, personal skills to manage a diverse range of clients across different sectors.  The workload will be varied including accounts, personal and company tax, audit, VAT, payroll and compliance services provided to a wide breadth of clients predominantly based in the Isle of Man but also in the UK and overseas.  

The successful candidate must be able to demonstrate their ability to prepare and file statutory accounts, sole trader and partnership accounts, personal and corporate tax returns including computations and schedules, and assist with reviews of work undertaken by other members of the team;  Plan and prepare for audits, including meeting with audit clients, preparing working papers, resolving queries, and executing audits in compliance with relevant auditing and accounting standards, and Isle of Man legislation.  Audits will involve a mix of on-site and office based tasks dependent on the nature of the client and the work to be undertaken.  There will be scope to develop existing and new relationships with clients, including audit clients, which will provide further opportunity to participate in the success of K5.

Applicants must have strong analytical skills, excellent communication skills and be converse with the latest accounts and audit software, as well as being proficient in Excel and other applications.  We are a busy office and being able to organise workloads and having good time management skills is essential to be able to prioritise work and meet deadlines.  Being able to work as part of a team and help train and mentor other staff is an important attribute but the right candidate must also be able to work independently and to use their own initiative to solve problems and complete tasks.  

The role is based on a full time hours (37.5hrs p.w.), although fexiblilty could be offerd depending on experience of applicant.

To apply, please forward your Curriculum Vitae (CV) together with a covering email to - Enquiries@K5ltd.im.   
(Tel: 01624 833776)

We are looking for individuals who are patient, trustworthy, flexible and genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in people's lives. The role involves flexible working hours, including mornings, evenings and weekends.

Notes
About the role
We are seeking a GDC-registered dentist to join our established practice in Ramsey, providing NHS and private dental care to patients on the Isle of Man. The role is permanent, working 35 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm, with a one-hour lunch break. 

Main duties and responsibilities:

Examine patients’ teeth, gums and jaw, using dental and X-ray equipment, and diagnose dental conditions.
Assess patients and recommend treatment options.
Administer local anaesthetics and carry out clinical treatments, including restorations, periodontal care and other general dentistry procedures.
Prescribe and administer treatment, and refer patients to specialists where necessary.
Advise patients on oral health and preventative care.
Keep accurate, confidential patient records in line with GDC standards.
Deliver both NHS-contracted and private treatment within the practice’s contracts.

Remuneration and Benefits:

£14–£17 per UDA, depending on experience and applicable contractual arrangements.
Private treatment remuneration on a 50% split, subject to the agreed contractual terms and laboratory costs.
Flexible UDA allocation, subject to agreement.
An established patient base.
A supportive clinical and administrative team.
Flexible working days, with full-time and part-time options.
Start date negotiable.

Essential skills, qualifications and experience:

A recognised dental degree, such as a BDS or equivalent, acceptable for registration and practice in the Isle of Man.
Full registration with the General Dental Council (GDC) and the necessary professional authorisation to practise in the Isle of Man by the start date.
Eligibility to undertake the NHS dental work required by the role, including any applicable performer-list or local authorisation requirements.
Experience in general dental practice and the ability to deliver a range of routine dental treatments safely and competently.
Good communication skills in English and the ability to work effectively as part of a clinical team.
Appropriate professional indemnity arrangements for the work undertaken.

How to apply

Please submit your CV and a covering letter outlining your qualifications, clinical experience, professional registration status and availability.

Email: opportunity@smiledentalcare.co.uk
Closing date: 10th of November, 2026

We are looking for a GDC-registered Dental Therapist to join our established practice and treat NHS and private patients. Carry out examinations, assessments and treatment planning within the GDC scope of practice for dental therapists.
Provide routine restorative treatment, including direct fillings and extractions of deciduous teeth, where permitted under the scope of practice.
Deliver periodontal care, scaling and polishing, and preventive treatments such as fluoride applications and fissure sealants.
Take dental radiographs and administer local anaesthesia, in line with GDC requirements.
Give patients oral health education and preventive advice.
Work with dentists, nurses and reception staff, and refer patients where treatment falls outside your scope.

Gross annual salary of £36,500, paid monthly by bank transfer.
Additional bonuses for private work.

A recognised qualification in dental therapy (diploma or degree) approved by the General Dental Council.

Notes
The successful candidate will join Be Well Physiotherapy & Pilates, a busy and growing clinic in Douglas, Isle of Man, specialising in Women’s Health, Pelvic Health and musculoskeletal physiotherapy. Initially, the role will involve taking over an established caseload during the clinic owner’s maternity leave, with the opportunity to continue in a permanent full-time position thereafter.

Key responsibilities will include managing a varied physiotherapy caseload, conducting thorough assessments, developing individualised treatment and rehabilitation programmes, and providing high-quality, patient-centred care.

Applicants must be HCPC-registered physiotherapists with a passion for clinical excellence, strong communication skills and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team. An interest in or experience of musculoskeletal physiotherapy and Women’s Health would be advantageous. Full-time hours are available, although working patterns are negotiable, with potential flexibility around school hours.

The successful applicant must be willing to relocate to the Isle of Man and have a valid UK passport or appropriate visa/right to work.

To apply, please email your CV and a brief covering letter outlining your experience and interest in the position to Sanchia Newman at **sanchia@bewell.im**. Shortlisted applicants will be contacted to arrange an online meeting to discuss the role and opportunity further. For enquiries, please contact Sanchia by email at the address above.

Additional Pilates qualifications, particularly in Mat and Reformer Pilates, would be a bonus and provide an opportunity to contribute to our established and busy Pilates programme.

We are seeking an enthusiastic and dynamic Registered Service Manager who has the drive and passion to develop a service and team to achieve success. The successful candidate will demonstrate integrity, compassion, and real commitment to working with Autism Initiatives as we progress through the next stage of our Adult Supported Living Service.

This is a very exciting time to join Autism Initiatives due to the continued growth.

You will lead and motivate the team to develop the overall quality of the service including individualised approaches, outcome focused support planning, contract management, finance, health and safety and staffing. The successful candidate will provide regular supervisions, guidance and direction to the team. To be successful in this role, you will have the ability to deliver a highly personalised service to adults with a diagnosis of ASC and actively encourage community access for service user’s and enable active participation in a variety of activities to increase their independence and live successful as a valued member of the community.

You will have experience inworking in a Health and Social Care setting and be able to evidence your contribution to positive outcomes for service users and your ability to fulfil this important role.

Ideally you will hold a Level 5 Health and Social Care qualification, or you will be required to obtain this qualification on successful appointment.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who hold a manual driving licence.

For more information, or to apply, please visit jobs.autisminitiatives.org.

Notes
Join a brilliant team on the Isle of Man, committed to supporting autistic people to live as independently as possible and to be part of their local community. Autism Initiatives work positively alongside people with autism, providing specialist services that are tailored to each individual.

We are seeking friendly Support Workers to join us at our Residential services. We have a number of houses located in Central and Northern parts of the Island within easy reach of local bus routes.

We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic and will enjoy joining a team that encourages people with autism to enjoy an active lifestyle. Community activities could include swimming, accessing walking groups or trips to the cinema or even camping trips and gorge walking. Support Workers promote health and well-being and support individuals to maintain their home. The support we deliver is flexible and unique to each individual, building on their strengths and driven by their goals.

Experience is not essential, but a genuine desire to making a difference to the lives of people with autism, as well as a positive attitude is. This is truly a rewarding role, with the opportunity for you to develop your skills, knowledge and fulfil your career aspirations.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who hold a manual driving licence.

For more information, or to apply, please visit jobs.autisminitiatives.org.

Notes
The successful candidate will join Be Well Physiotherapy & Pilates, a busy and growing clinic in Douglas, Isle of Man, specialising in Women’s Health, Pelvic Health and musculoskeletal physiotherapy. Initially, the role will involve taking over an established caseload during the clinic owner’s maternity leave, with the opportunity to continue in a permanent full-time position thereafter.

Key responsibilities will include managing a varied physiotherapy caseload, conducting thorough assessments, developing individualised treatment and rehabilitation programmes, and providing high-quality, patient-centred care.

Applicants must be HCPC-registered physiotherapists with a passion for clinical excellence, strong communication skills and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team. An interest in or experience of musculoskeletal physiotherapy and Women’s Health would be advantageous. Full-time hours are available, although working patterns are negotiable, with potential flexibility around school hours.

The successful applicant must be willing to relocate to the Isle of Man and have a valid UK passport or appropriate visa/right to work.

To apply, please email your CV and a brief covering letter outlining your experience and interest in the position to Sanchia Newman at **sanchia@bewell.im**. Shortlisted applicants will be contacted to arrange an online meeting to discuss the role and opportunity further. For enquiries, please contact Sanchia by email at the address above.

Additional Pilates qualifications, particularly in Mat and Reformer Pilates, would be a bonus and provide an opportunity to contribute to our established and busy Pilates programme.

Notes
Barista Costa Coffee Sea Terminal,  ready for the next level?

At Costa Coffee, we are what we craft. It's about perfecting latte art, creating experiences that put a smile on people's faces, and proudly making greatness every day. 

We’re passionate about being a great place to work with our Sea Terminal store, where you can bring your real self into our mix.    Making our drinks with heart, giving our customers a warm welcome and a lasting impression so they come back to our stores and enjoy an exceptional experience. 

What you’ll do.  Being a Barista means so much more than making velvety cups of joy. It’s your chance to learn, challenge yourself and truly master your craft the Costa Way - which means you’ll be: Putting smiles on faces come rain or shine; Mastering our menu, from toasties to seasonal drinks and more; Pouring passion into perfect drinks and great customer service; Keeping your store clean, tidy and welcoming; Working with your colleagues to make our stores the very best. 

Who you are?   You will be a Barista with at least 2 years experience who has mastered the bar or have worked for at least 2 years in a similar hospitality environment.  You will be ambitious, love to lead by example to create a collaborative team culture and are ready for the next step to be mentored for progression from Barista to Shift Leader and Assistant Manager.  

We’re interested in your unique ingredients:  A multi-tasker with a can-do attitude; not afraid to take on a challenge; A perfectionist, dedicated to delivering excellence; A people person and a team player, who can strike up a good conversation, lead and inspire to drive exceptional performance to exceed our Key Performance Indicators.   You will be passionate about hospitality and creating great guest experiences.    

What we can offer: We’re really proud of the work our team members deliver, and we want you to feel valued and rewarded.   Our starting rate is £12.86 p/h, increasing upon progression from Barista to Shift leader and Assistant Manager.   Free hot and cold drinks on shift, plus discount on food and bottled drinks. 20 days paid holiday increasing to 25 days, Recognition and performance related rewards. 

Please email your CV and covering letter outlining why you wish to become part of the Costa Team to hrteam@fancyacoffee.im

This is an opportunity to take a leading role in a well?regarded venue with a varied service offering, a supportive team and room to shape the future direction of the kitchen.

Notes
Head Chef

We’re looking for an experienced and passionate Head Chef to lead a busy hospitality kitchen, delivering consistently great food while creating a positive, well-organised environment for the team.

You’ll take ownership of the day-to-day kitchen operation, including food quality and presentation, team leadership and development, stock and ordering, food costs and wastage, menu development, and maintaining excellent standards of food safety, hygiene and kitchen compliance.

You’ll ideally have previous experience as a Head Chef, Kitchen Manager or experienced Sous Chef, together with a recognised professional cookery qualification such as NVQ Level 2/3, City & Guilds or equivalent, although substantial industry experience will also be considered.

A recognised Food Safety/Food Hygiene qualification is required, along with a good working knowledge of HACCP, allergen management and kitchen health & safety. You’ll also be confident managing stock, controlling costs and leading and developing a kitchen team.

Most importantly, we’re looking for someone who is hands-on, organised and passionate about great food, with the confidence to take ownership of their kitchen and lead from the front.

Whether you’re an established Head Chef or an experienced Sous Chef ready to take the next step, we’d love to hear from you. 

Apply here: https://careers.hb.im/job/head-chef-5834891?source=hb.im

Job Title:     Costa Assistant Manager
Vacancies:  1

Salary:         £28,250 PA
Contact:      Chanelle Davey
Tel No.         01624 823538
Email:           iomcosta@caterleisure.co.uk 

We're Costa, the nation's favourite coffee shop brand, pouring our heart and soul into everything we do and creating moments to remember for our customers, our communities and for each other. Together we turn sips into smiles, choices into opportunities and passions into careers. Help us spread a little happiness.

Store Team Role - Assistant Manager
As the Assistant Manager you will assist the Manager in all aspects of the job. You need to be commercially aware, with the presence and personality to influence the day-to-day business. Along with delivering excellent customer service, you will be expected to lead by example, setting high standards, driving sales and controlling profits. We will expect you to provide a high level of customer service whilst maintaining health and hygiene at all times. You are required to be energetic, enthusiastic, responsible, trustworthy, hardworking and reliable.

Responsibilities
Daily running of the unit.
Organising staff shifts.
Ensuring that all members of your team are trained in food / drink preparation, and comply with all aspects of our Health and Safety and Food Safety Policies

Safety policies.
Ensure all company and unit reports are completed efficiently.
Company merchandising and standards are adhered to ensuring a consistently high level of store standards are maintained.
Stock procedures are managed and controlled within agreed targets and policies to ensure minimal wastage.
Liaise with clients and suppliers on a regular basis to ensure a constant offering of food and beverages of a high quality.
Communication with your team (and the overall company) recognising the importance of managing staff morale, ensuring all staff are continually developed using the company's training programme.
Experience and Qualifications
Previous experience of working within a customer facing environment.
Supervisory experience.
Enthusiasm to execute outstanding customer service.
Positive attitude with willingness.
Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to communicate effectively with customers, clients, and staff at all levels.
Ability to achieve and set standards and operate to performance criteria, with particular regard to hygiene.
Ability to work effectively as part of a team desirable:
Previous experience within a coffee environment.
Ideal candidate must drive and be able to arrive at the airport for shifts commencing at 5 a.m. 

What we Offer You: 
Free Parking.
Free meals.
Free Uniforms.
‘Employee Assistance Programme’ provided to all employees.

Please apply in writing and include a CV, and email it to iomcosta@caterleisure.co.uk

Tel: 01624 823538
Vacancies will be advertised for 1 month. If you do not hear from us after 1 month, please assume your application has been unsuccessful

Experienced Front of House Assistant – Award-Winning Plant-Based Restaurant

Vibe Plant Based Cafe & Restaurant is looking for an experienced, enthusiastic and hospitality-driven Front of House Assistant to join our small, close-knit team. We’re an award-winning, independent restaurant in the heart of Douglas, passionate about great food, genuine connections and creating memorable experiences for everyone who walks through our door.

We’re looking for a natural host who genuinely loves people and takes pride in looking after them. Someone with a great personality, strong hospitality experience and the confidence to manage a restaurant floor, making every customer feel welcome, valued and cared for.
This is a varied, hands-on role in a small team, so multitasking, initiative and excellent attention to detail are essential. You’ll need to work efficiently, prioritise tasks and keep everything running smoothly, while knowing when to step away from the jobs list and give customers the time and attention they deserve.
Responsibilities include setting up the restaurant, stocking fridges and workstations, taking orders and payments, serving customers, managing reservations and answering the telephone. You’ll prepare quality barista coffees, fresh juices, smoothies and other drinks, confidently recommend menu items and help create a beautiful atmosphere. Keeping the restaurant clean and tidy, including staying on top of the daily front-of-house washing up, is an important part of the role. Everyone mucks in, and we’re looking for someone who takes pride in every aspect of their work.
Creativity, initiative and a good eye for detail are a real bonus. We’re passionate about plant-based food and inspiring people through what we do, so you’ll need to understand and represent the Vibe ethos with warmth and enthusiasm. We want someone who can hit the ground running, work independently when needed and become a valued part of our little Vibe family.

Hours and availability
We’re recruiting for Wednesdays, Thursdays, Fridays and Saturdays, with daytime shifts starting at 11:30am and finishing between 3:00pm and 3:30pm, or evening shifts starting at 5:15pm until the end of service. We’re happy to consider separate candidates for daytime and evening shifts, or one person looking for a combination of shifts. The position is available immediately.
If you’re an experienced hospitality professional who loves looking after people and wants to be part of an independent, award-winning restaurant where the little details matter, we’d love to hear from you.

Minimum age 18 with experience only 
To apply, please email your CV and a little information about yourself and your experience to hello@vibecafe.im.

Our client seeks a Risk & Governance Analyst to be responsible for supporting the effective operation of the Technology & Change risk and governance framework. The role ensures that risk, control, policy, audit, outsourcing and regulatory activities are coordinated, monitored and reported in a timely and consistent manner. Working closely with Technology leadership, risk owners and key stakeholders, the role helps maintain a strong control environment through the management of risk assessments, risk registers, policy reviews, supplier governance and audit activities, while supporting compliance with internal standards and regulatory requirements. Key Skills and Experience: Experience working within a risk, controls, Audit and/or governance role. Strong understanding of risk management and control frameworks, including risk assessments, root cause analysis (RCA), corrective and preventative actions, remediation planning, control monitoring and continuous improvement activities. Demonstrates initiative, accountability and a sense of ownership for delivering outcomes. Effective communicator with strong organisational and coordination skills, able to manage competing priorities and maintain attention to detail. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate risks, identify root causes, assess impacts and support effective practical solutions. Ability to produce prompt, accurate, clear and concise reporting. Experience performing GAP analysis identifying areas for improvement and supporting areas for remediation. Ability to work with senior managers, risk owners, auditors and suppliers. Experience using AI tools to support risk management, governance and control activities, while ensuring appropriate governance and responsible use of AI. Relevant Risk, Governance, Audit or IT certifications (ie IRM Certificate in Risk Management, ISO 27001 etc). Knowledge of the Financial Services. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16824

Notes
To Apply for the Role, please follow the following link - 
https://apogeecorp.ciphr-irecruit.com/applicants/vacancy/840/Technical-Consultant---3rd-Line

As a 3rd Line Support Technician, you are a senior escalation point within Apogee’s support model. You will handle the most complex incidents that cannot be resolved by 1st or 2nd line teams, while also taking ownership of infrastructure stability, technical improvements, and project delivery.

You will work independently and collaboratively on infrastructure changes, new deployments, and onboarding new customers. You will also play a key role in setting standards, improving documentation, and feeding knowledge back into the wider support teams.

This role suits someone who enjoys depth, responsibility, and working at enterprise scale.

What you will be doing
Acting as a final escalation point for complex technical issues
Maintaining and improving customer IT infrastructure, including patching and upgrades
Designing, implementing, and supporting technical solutions across server, cloud, and network environments
Contributing to infrastructure change, system improvements, and new deployments
Supporting client onboarding and producing high-quality technical documentation
Providing guidance and technical direction to 1st and 2nd line teams
Working within change control and service management processes
Supporting customers professionally via phone, email, and self-service portals
Participating in an on-call rota (up to one week in every four)
Continuing technical development through training and certifications

A typical working pattern is Monday to Friday, 08:30 to 17:30, with a one-hour lunch break. This role also offers flexibility to work from home, typically two days per week for a five-day working week

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED
You will be a confident 3rd Line engineer with strong Microsoft, infrastructure, and networking capability, and experience working in enterprise or public sector environments.

Essential technical experience includes:
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 and Azure
Strong experience in SCCM System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM)
Proven ability to implement and manage Microsoft Entra, Intune, Autopilot, and Defender
Strong working knowledge of Windows Server environments (2016+), including AD, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and RDS
Experience maintaining Hybrid Active Directory environments
Experience with virtualisation platforms such as Hyper-V or VMware
Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including VLANs, routing, firewalls, and WiFi
Experience working as a 3rd line escalation point within a tiered support model
Strong awareness of IT security best practice
We value candidates with AI literacy – individuals who are curious about technology, comfortable exploring automation, and eager to contribute to a modern, forward-thinking business.

Notes
We are looking for a highly analytical and commercially minded Promotions Strategy & Optimisation Manager to drive the performance of promotions, campaigns and bonuses across our Sportsbook and Casino products.
Key Responsibilities
Promotions & Performance Optimisation:
Lead the optimisation of promotions, campaigns and bonus activity across Sportsbook and Casino.  Analyse performance to understand which offers and mechanics are delivering against their objectives.  Identify inefficient or underperforming activity and recommend improvements to targeting, mechanics, rewards and timing.
Identify opportunities to scale or further improve successful promotions.   Define and monitor KPIs including promotional cost, participation, conversion, retention, engagement and player value.  Assess the incremental impact of promotional activity to understand the true value generated.  Establish a strong test-and-learn approach using A/B testing, control groups and experimentation.
Personalisation & Automation:
Work with CRM, BI, Product and other teams to improve promotional targeting and personalisation.  Identify opportunities to use player behaviour, preferences and value to determine the most relevant offer, reward and timing.  Support the development of automated promotional decision-making and personalised journeys.
Explore how predictive models and machine learning can improve promotional effectiveness.  Define success measures and continuously evaluate automated activity.
Innovation & Collaboration:
Keep up to date with developments in Sportsbook and Casino promotions, bonusing and player engagement.  Monitor competitor activity and identify new mechanics, capabilities and opportunities.  Bring new ideas to the Promotions team and challenge existing approaches where data suggests there is a better way.
Work closely with Promotions, CRM, BI and Product to turn insights into practical improvements.  The above duties provide a generic description of the Employee’s day to day responsibilities but should in no way be deemed to be an exhaustive list. Additional related, duties may be assigned by the Line Manager in line with business exigencies and continuity.
What We're Looking For:
Experience in promotions, bonusing, CRM, commercial analytics, player analytics or a related optimisation role.  Experience within Sportsbook, Casino, iGaming or a similar digital industry.  A highly analytical and data-driven mindset with strong commercial judgement.  Experience evaluating campaign or promotional performance against clear objectives.  A strong understanding of segmentation, targeting and personalisation.  Experience with experimentation and test-and-learn methodologies.
An understanding of how automation and machine learning can support marketing and promotional decision-making.  The ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.  Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

For more details and to apply contact talent@silverspin.com or 07624269891.

Key Responsibilities
 Translate the group strategy and business plan into an executable operating plan for the Isle of Man and its extended trade offices (Monaco, Ghana and Senegal). Track delivery against agreed objectives.
 Lead and implement the commercial strategy in conjunction with the GPL’s and IOM commercial teams for the procurement, marketing, and distribution of agricultural commodities by identifying market opportunities, strengthening relationships with customers and strategic suppliers, and ensuring the competitiveness of the business.
 Ensure compliance with the budget, profitability (P&L), cash flow generation, and the efficient management of working capital, ensuring the financial sustainability of the region.
 Oversee the comprehensive management of commercial, financial, operational, and market risks, including exposure to price, foreign exchange, credit, and counterparty risks, ensuring compliance with corporate policies.
 Ensure compliance with corporate policies, ethical standards, internal controls, corporate governance, and applicable legislation in each of the countries under its responsibility.
 Lead, develop, and strengthen a high-performing team, promoting a culture based on leadership, accountability, collaboration, innovation, talent development, and results orientation.
 Build and maintain clear performance dashboards and KPIs. Give the VP Supply Chain and group stakeholders accurate, timely insight on results, risks and opportunities.
 Present business results, key risks, opportunities, and strategic plans to the VP Supply Chain, ensuring informed decision-making.
 Perform other duties as assigned.
Qualifications & Experience
Essential
Minimum of 10 years of professional experience, including at least 4 years in senior leadership positions. A benefit of also having full responsibility for business results (P&L).
Industry experience in the trading of agricultural commodities, or agribusiness, or food, or raw materials, or related industries.
A demonstrated ability to lead and develop teams, and to be trusted by colleagues across functions.
Qualification in Business Administration, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Finance, International Business, or related fields.
Preferred
Experience within a commodity trading, agricultural, or related multinational trading business
Proficiency in MS365 applications including Excel, Word, Teams, and SharePoint; experience with AI and large language model (LLM) tools is a further advantage
Experience operating within a Fortune 500 or publicly listed group reporting structure
Exposure to data warehouse integrations, BI reporting tools (e.g., Copilot, PowerBI), and automation solutions.
To apply send your CV to matthew.bird@seaboardtrade.com DIRECT APPLICATIONS ONLY PLEASE

We’re looking for a Crew Operations Manager to lead day to day fleet operations and power the next chapter of our company’s growth. If you’ve built your craft at sea and want to amplify your leadership ashore, this is your chance to shape outcomes across safety, reliability, people, and performance, while growing your own leadership portfolio at pace.
The role requires sailing experience as a senior officer on LNG carriers, together with a thorough understanding of the shipping industry and tanker operations. Given the nature of the position, the successful candidate must have substantial strong solid expertise relevant to LNG and tanker vessels, including operational, safety, regulatory and commercial knowledge that can only be acquired through significant seagoing and fleet management experience.
Our fleet is expanding. We need an operations leader who understands ships, crews, ports, and most importantly, the realities of seagoing life, someone who can translate that insight into outstanding operational delivery and continuous improvement. You’ll help us deliver on our vision: the right people, in the right place, at the right time, at the right cost, every voyage, every time.
Lead end-to-end crew operations
Ensure safe, compliant, reliable, and cost-effective manning for the fleet. Oversee day-to-day crewing delivery across a diverse seafarer population, ensuring the right people are deployed to the right vessel at the right time. Apply practical operational knowledge of LNG and tanker operations to assess competence requirements, operational risks, and vessel-specific crewing needs.
Lead end-to-end crew operations
Ensure safe, compliant, reliable, and cost-effective manning for the fleet. Oversee day-to-day crewing delivery across a diverse seafarer population, ensuring the right people are deployed to the right vessel at the right time. Search & Select is proud to be partnering with a distinguished international financial services organisation to identify an exceptional individual for a rare and high-impact board-level appointment. Our client is a well-established, internationally respected institution that delivers sophisticated banking, lending, investment, fiduciary and wealth management solutions to globally mobile and affluent clients. Backed by the scale and ambition of one of the worlds most formidable banking groups, this is an organisation with genuine strategic purpose, world-class governance frameworks and a culture that values independent thought, inclusive leadership and constructive challenge. The opportunity: Independent Non-Executive Director (INED) & Board Audit Committee Chair. This is a permanent, board-level appointment carrying both the prestige and the responsibility that come with chairing a Board Audit Committee within a regulated international banking environment. You will bring independent judgement and strategic insight to a high-performing board, while leading the audit committee's oversight of financial reporting, internal and external audit, internal controls and the wider assurance framework. You will also contribute meaningfully to strategy, risk management, regulatory compliance and governance making this a role where your voice truly shapes outcomes. What we are looking for: A proven track record in senior audit, accounting, assurance or audit-governance roles. Previous experience chairing a Board Audit Committee - this is an essential requirement. Strong financial literacy with expertise in financial reporting, internal controls and integrated assurance. Relevant AML/CFT and financial crime experience to challenge management and assess regulatory risk. Previous Independent Non-Executive Director experience within a regulated financial services environment. Type: Permanent. Time Commitment: Minimum 36 days per year. IOM resident and be able to attend board meetings in person .This is a purposeful boardroom environment where independent challenge is not just welcomed it is essential. If you are a credible, commercially aware and values-driven senior leader ready to make a meaningful contribution at board level, we want to hear from you. For a confidential conversation, contact the Search & Select team  or please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16876

Notes
Home Help / Nanny–Housekeeper.
Part-Time or Full-Time (Term Time & School Holidays).
We are a busy family looking for a dependable, caring, and organised home help to support our household and care for our two daughters, aged 7 and 10.
We are open to either a part-time role focused on after-school care, or a full-time role combining childcare and household support during term time, with more childcare focus in school holidays.
Part-Time Role – After-School Care.
Responsibilities include:
Collecting our children from school.
Preparing and serving healthy, nutritious meals.
Taking the children to after-school clubs and activities (and getting their bags ready for the clubs).
Ensuring the children are safe, well cared for, and supported after school.
This role would suit someone looking for regular afternoon/evening hours during term time.
Full-Time Role – Nanny–Housekeeper.
Responsibilities include:
All after-school childcare duties listed above.
Helping to run the household on a day-to-day basis.
General housekeeping tasks such as tidying, laundry, shopping, meal preparation and keeping the home organised.
Supporting the smooth running of the household.
During school holidays, the role will place a greater emphasis on childcare, including caring for the children during the day and keeping them engaged and active.
Requirements (Both Roles).
A kind, responsible, and reliable nature.
Experience caring for children of a similar age (preferred).
Ability to prepare healthy meals.
A clean driving licence and use of your own car (Petrol money will be provided as part of the remuneration).
A clean, enhanced DBS check (or willingness to obtain one).
Organised, proactive, and trustworthy.
We Offer:
Choice of part-time or full-time employment.
A friendly family environment.
Competitive pay, depending on experience and hours.
If this role sounds like a good fit for you, we would love to hear from you. Call 07624206008

To create with the Managing Director co-ordinated, detailed annual plans, in line with defined long term goals, for each section of the business covering all targets for profitability, productivity, resource control and market development. To monitor continuously all adverse trends and potential problems and take corrective action in a timely manner.

ii. 	To create and establish the organisation and staffing for each  
department structures and job positions; agree job descriptions and         responsibilities; undertake interviewing and selection as required; ensure the provision of contracts of employment policies in line with existing legislation.

      credit limits; customer service levels; warranty and guarantee policies; 
      resource control; liaison with suppliers; discounting; payment and 
benefit plans.
      
vi. 	Monitor continuously all market place activities to identify potential 
      threats and opportunities and adjust plans and objectives accordingly, 
      including: competitor actions in products and services; customer
      changes; economic trends; legislation; market trends and analysis;
      pricing and discounting and customer service levels.

This role is responsible for supervising the operation and maintenance of the Island’s wastewater network, ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality service delivery while promoting Manx Utilities’ values, policies, and health and safety standards. The position involves leading and supporting frontline teams, allocating workloads, monitoring performance, managing training needs, approving timesheets and leave, procuring materials and equipment, and maintaining effective communication between management and staff. The supervisor is also expected to undertake operational tasks, inspect wastewater infrastructure projects, assist with maintenance planning, generate operational reports, and contribute to emergency response activities. The ideal candidate will have extensive knowledge of wastewater infrastructure, civil engineering, and construction practices, along with proven supervisory experience, strong communication and leadership skills, a commitment to continuous improvement, and the ability to work safely in challenging environments, including confined spaces, out-of-hours duties, and emergency callouts.
Find out more and apply through our website - https://www.manxutilities.im/careers/vacancies

Our client seeks a Head of Compliance & MLRO to join their team and lead the compliance function of the investment business. This is a pivotal leadership opportunity for an experienced compliance professional where you will be the firm's primary regulatory contact with the IOMFSA, lead the financial crime compliance framework, and provide independent, board-level oversight across regulatory, conduct, legal, operational and reputational risk. Key Skills and Experience: A relevant professional qualification (e.g. ICA, CISI, ACAMS) or a minimum of 5 years' senior experience in Compliance, Risk, Internal Audit or Legal within a regulated financial services environment. Detailed working knowledge of the IOM regulatory framework, including the Financial Services Act 2008, Regulated Activities Order 2011, Financial Services Rule Book 2016 and AML/CFT Code 2019. Proven experience operating as an MLRO or Senior Compliance Officer within an IOMFSA-regulated investment business. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with demonstrable experience presenting to Boards, senior management and internal committees. Ability to work independently, manage a varied workload under pressure and deliver consistently to deadline. Systematic and detail-oriented approach, with the capability to identify risk, drive remediation and evidence outcomes. Experience developing and delivering compliance training programmes. Sound understanding of AML, CFT, CPF, sanctions and data protection obligations in a regulated financial services context. 
 For a full list of responsibilities and requirements or to apply for this great role, please visit the website at searchandselect.com, quoting the reference number:  16848

Notes
Our client seeks a diligent and detail-oriented Compliance Administrator to support the compliance framework. You will assist the Head of Compliance and Directors in ensuring that the business meets its statutory, regulatory, and internal governance obligations. Key Responsibilities: Assist with customer due diligence (CDD) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) checks for new and existing clients. Conduct periodic reviews of client files to ensure documentation is complete, accurate, and up to date. Perform screening of clients, beneficial owners, and connected parties. Support the identification and escalation of suspicious activity in line with internal procedures. Help maintain compliance registers, including breaches, complaints, PEPs, sanctions, and training logs. Assist in monitoring compliance with the Isle of Man Financial Services Authority's Regulatory and AML/CFT Frameworks. Support thematic reviews, and business risk assessments. Contribute to the preparation of compliance reports for the board. Assist in drafting, updating and maintaining compliance policies and procedures. Help ensure staff are aware of regulatory changes and internal policy updates. Respond to internal queries about compliance, CDD requirements, and regulatory obligations. Assist with onboarding processes and ongoing monitoring workflows. Support the Client Services team in improving data quality within Reverto. Key Skills and Experience: Essential: Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. Good understanding of Isle of Man AML/CFT and regulatory expectations. Excellent organisational and time-management skills. Strong written and verbal communication abilities. Ability to work with confidential information with discretion and professionalism. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office. 5 GCSEs or equivalent at grade C or above. Desirable: Experience within a TCSP, fiduciary, or financial services environment. Familiarity with IOMFSA Rulebook, AML/CFT Code, and relevant legislation. Working knowledge of screening tools and Reverto. Progress toward a relevant qualification (for example, certificate in regulation, AML or Trust Estate Practitioner). 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16851

Assist with onboarding processes and ongoing monitoring workflows. Support the Client Services team in improving data quality within Reverto. Key Skills and Experience: Essential: Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. Good understanding of Isle of Man AML/CFT and regulatory expectations. Excellent organisational and time-management skills. Strong written and verbal communication abilities. Ability to work with confidential information with discretion and professionalism. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office. 5 GCSEs or equivalent at grade C or above. Desirable: Experience within a TCSP, fiduciary, or financial services environment.
