Our client seeks a Group FATCA/CRS Reporting Officer to join their team. Role Profile: A key reporting role, based at Group-level, with the opportunity for the successful candidate to step into the world of FATCA/CRS compliance and contribute to an exciting period of transformation, as the Group establishes a central function to manage reporting obligations, pursuant to the United States' Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) and the OECD Common Reporting Standard (CRS). You will support the annual end-to-end reporting process, ensuring entity classifications are undertaken in an accurate and timely manner, resultant classifications and associated rationales are logged within the core database, and that Reportable Persons hold valid/reasonable self-certifications, while supporting the Group with AEOI-related queries, escalating where necessary. Key Skills and Responsibilities: A working knowledge of FATCA/CRS and its application to the trust and company sector - pensions an advantage. Ability to complete associated documentation (self-certifications, W-8 and W-9) while explaining the rationale to client-facing teams. Experience of undertaking entity classifications within trust and company structures. Able to work with, understand, and process large volumes of data - CSV, Excel, and XML in particular. A basic understanding of data protection laws and their application to data exchanged under AEOI. 
 For a full list of responsibilities and requirements or to apply for this great role, please visit the website at searchandselect.com, quoting the reference number:  16932

Feel Connected to the future at Sure by joining as a HR Assistant in Guernsey or the Isle of Man. 

To drive the role forward, the individual will be responsible for delivering a high-volume, high-quality, accurate and responsive HR administration service for the full employee lifecycle across multiple operating jurisdictions. Working in a fast-paced environment with frequently competing deadlines, the role holder plans and prioritises a varied workload, completes time-critical processes accurately and identifies wider implications, dependencies or risks before action is taken. This role supports the HR Advisor and Senior HR Manager in providing a professional and compliant HR generalist service across the Sure Group.

Sure are looking for candidates who would like to feel connected to future technologies and change, global opportunities, personal development, and working in a great team. Passionate about their people and communities, the ideal individual would hold the following skills:

CIPD Level 3 Qualified
Practical HR administration experience within a fast-paced commercial environment
Exceptional organisation, planning and prioritisation skills
Resilient & adaptable when managing changing priorities and sustained periods of high workload
We are proud of the “way we do things” at Sure; We work together as One Team, We strive for Customer Satisfaction, We are Reliable, We have a Passion for Technology & Learning and We are Community & Sustainability Focused, and individuals applying will “feel connected” to our Company values

Notes
Manavia has a vacancy for a Senior Administrator, eGaming Operations. The role suits a senior eGaming administrator who is looking for a new challenge or ready to take the next step in their career.

About the role
You will be responsible for managing all of the administrative, regulatory and compliance requirements across a portfolio of eGaming clients. You will build close working relationships with the licensed operators you look after, running regular client meetings and supporting them through the licensing process. You will maintain their policies, procedures and regulatory reporting, help to develop and implement the team's processes and procedures, and work across the wider group of companies.

About you
You will have at least three years' experience within the trust and corporate service provider (TCSP) industry, and you will be approved by the Isle of Man Gambling Supervision Commission and Financial Services Authority to act as a director of client companies. You will bring a strong knowledge of eGaming operations, regulation and compliance, and the organisational skills to manage a busy portfolio with minimal supervision. Your written and verbal communication will be strong, and you will be discreet, with a natural ability to build honest, transparent and close working relationships both inside the firm and with clients. You will hold, or be working towards, a relevant professional qualification, or be qualified by experience.

Why join us?
We offer a competitive salary, a friendly working environment and genuine opportunities to progress your career. You will be based in our new offices at 10-12 Victoria Street, Douglas, as part of a team that has grown alongside the Island's eGaming sector.

How to apply
Please send your CV and covering letter to info@manavia.im, or by post to Manavia Limited, 10-12 Victoria Street, Douglas, Isle of Man. To find out more, visit www.manavia.im/careers.

Manavia has a vacancy for a Senior Administrator, eGaming Operations. The role suits a senior eGaming administrator who is looking for a new challenge or ready to take the next step in their career.

About the role
You will be responsible for managing all of the administrative, regulatory and compliance requirements across a portfolio of eGaming clients. You will build close working relationships with the licensed operators you look after, running regular client meetings and supporting them through the licensing process. You will maintain their policies, procedures and regulatory reporting, help to develop and implement the team's processes and procedures, and work across the wider group of companies.

About you
You will have at least three years' experience within the trust and corporate service provider (TCSP) industry, and you will be approved by the Isle of Man Gambling Supervision Commission and Financial Services Authority to act as a director of client companies. You will bring a strong knowledge of eGaming operations, regulation and compliance, and the organisational skills to manage a busy portfolio with minimal supervision. Your written and verbal communication will be strong, and you will be discreet, with a natural ability to build honest, transparent and close working relationships both inside the firm and with clients. You will hold, or be working towards, a relevant professional qualification, or be qualified by experience.

Why join us?
We offer a competitive salary, a friendly working environment and genuine opportunities to progress your career. You will be based in our new offices at 10-12 Victoria Street, Douglas, as part of a team that has grown alongside the Island's eGaming sector.

How to apply
Please send your CV and covering letter to info@manavia.im, or by post to Manavia Limited, 10-12 Victoria Street, Douglas, Isle of Man. To find out more, visit www.manavia.im/careers.

Preparing screens for printing.
Mixing inks and matching colours.
Screen printing a wide range of garments to a high standard.
Maintaining a clean, organised and efficient working environment.
Working closely with the team to ensure orders are completed accurately and on time.
 
What we're looking for:

 
Previous experience in screen printing would be an advantage, but it's not essential, as full training will be provided. 

More importantly, we're looking for someone with a positive attitude, a strong work ethic and a willingness to learn and develop their skills. 

Attention to detail is essential, along with the ability to work both independently and as part of a close-knit team. 

A clean driving licence would also be beneficial. 

Work Permit Requirement: Applicants must already hold a full, valid Isle of Man work permit or have unrestricted permission to work on the Island. 

Hours, holiday entitlement, and rates of pay will be discussed with successful applicants. 

If you're reliable, enthusiastic, and looking for an opportunity to learn a skilled trade within a friendly, established business, we'd love to hear from you!

We're looking for an organised, creative and enthusiastic Marketing & Communications Executive to join our busy Group Marketing team.

Based at our Isle of Man head office, you'll work alongside our in-house marketing and design team, supporting a wide variety of marketing activities across our property developments and business operations in the UK, Isle of Man and Jersey. This is a varied role, ideal for someone with a broad marketing background who enjoys managing multiple projects, creating engaging content and seeing ideas through to delivery. At this stage we will only be considering applications from Isle of Man based applicants who do not require an employment visa.

About the role

Working closely with our design studio and regional marketing teams, your responsibilities will include:

Supporting the planning and delivery of marketing campaigns and promotional activities.
Coordinating creative briefs and managing projects through our in-house design studio.
Writing and adapting copy for advertising, marketing collateral and communications.
Assisting with the production and distribution of marketing and promotional materials.
Coordinating promotional content for resident events across our UK build to rent developments.
Supporting digital marketing campaigns through the coordination of creative assets, and assisting with the creation and scheduling of organic social media content.
Liaising with internal teams and external suppliers to ensure projects are delivered on time.
Providing general marketing and administrative support to the wider team.

About you
We're looking for someone who is proactive, adaptable and highly organised, with excellent communication skills and a genuine enthusiasm for marketing.
You'll ideally have:

At least two years' experience in a marketing or communications role, either in-house or agency side.
Excellent copywriting skills and a strong eye for detail.
Experience coordinating marketing projects and working with creative teams.
The ability to manage multiple priorities and work to deadlines.
Confidence communicating with colleagues, stakeholders and external suppliers.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
A positive, flexible approach and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
Experience managing organic social media content for business accounts, particularly Facebook and Instagram, would be an advantage. Familiarity with Canva or social media scheduling platforms would also be beneficial, although not essential.

Notes
Our client is a well-established Private Family Office, spanning a diverse portfolio of sectors including technology and AI, commercial property and land, waste management and recycling, and mechanical engineering - this is a sophisticated private office with an impressive breadth of activity. They are seeking a Private Family Office Lawyer to join their team and work directly and closely alongside the Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO), providing comprehensive legal, commercial and administrative support across their extensive personal, property and business interests. This is not a traditional in-house legal position. Whilst a sound legal background is essential, this role demands equal comfort with practical business matters, third-party coordination and administrative responsibilities. Qualified lawyers are encouraged to apply, and our client would equally consider a highly experienced and commercially capable paralegal. Key Responsibilities: Support and oversee the UBO's personal legal matters, including contracts, property transactions, estate planning and liaison with external legal advisers. Oversee a substantial UK commercial property and land portfolio, including acquisitions, disposals, leases, title matters, asset protection and general estate management. Provide legal and commercial assistance across the UBO's diverse business interests, including contract reviews, negotiations and general corporate matters. Liaise with accountants, company secretaries and professional service providers to coordinate statutory returns, annual accounts, company filings and ongoing corporate compliance. Review, draft, negotiate and monitor a variety of legal and commercial agreements across the UBO's personal and business interests. Act as a central point of contact for external solicitors, accountants, banks, property managers, surveyors, consultants and other professional advisers. Take ownership of ad hoc projects and matters arising across the UBO's affairs, ensuring actions are progressed and completed in a timely manner. Help safeguard the UBO's personal and commercial interests by identifying legal, contractual, property and operational risks and ensuring appropriate action is taken. Key Skills and Experience: A qualified lawyer or experienced paralegal with a broad legal and commercial background. Experience across corporate, commercial, property or private client matters...

For a full list of responsibilities and requirements or to apply for this great role, please visit the website at searchandselect.com, quoting the reference number: 16937

Notes
Our client seeks a Client Relationship Manager to join their team. As a Client Relationship Manager your work directly supports the Groups commitment to provide thoughtful, personal and high-quality service to all clients. Working with the Engagement Lead within the Fiduciary Team, your skills and expertise will keep relationships with existing clients healthy and secure. Key Responsibilities: Liaise with clients, advisors, banks and professionals to ensure smooth administration. Maintain accurate client data in fiduciary systems. Draft Board packs, meeting minutes, resolutions and correspondence. Monitor compliance with AML, KYC and other regulatory requirements. Conduct file reviews and ensure timely reporting. Maintain proactive client engagement, always seeking solutions to meet their needs. Partner with the New Business team to identify and pursue new referral channels. Key Accountabilities: Act as Key Person as defined by the Financial Services Authority, ensuring the expected standards are achieved. Strengthen internal team capability by mentoring and knowledge sharing with team members. Delivery of co-ordinated, efficient and compliant operations across your portfolio of clients. Key Skills and Experience: Attained or working towards a STEP or CGI qualification. A minimum of 5 years' experience in the TSCP sector is required. Prior experience of using ViewPoint and Laserfiche would be advantageous. A natural communicator, with emotional intelligence to truly make each client feel valued. Deeply knowledgeable of fiduciary structures and trust administration, and confident to guide and mentor team members. Highly organised approach to inbox, calendar and filing management. Comfortable to navigate Microsoft Office suite of products. Able to bring a flexible and hands-on style with a healthy dose of common sense to everything that you do. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16938

Feel Connected to the future at Sure by joining the Finance Team as a Head of Procurement, PMO & Governance, working 37.5 hours per week.

To drive the role forward, the individual will lead Sure’s procurement, project management and governance capabilities, securing sustainable commercial value, disciplined investment decisions and effective oversight of the Group’s project portfolio. The postholder sets strategy and standards, advises the CFO and Executive team, and ensures material supplier, delivery and governance risks are visible and managed. This role reports to the CFO and directly manages the Procurement Manager and PMO Manager, who lead day-to-day activity in their respective functions.

Sure are looking for candidates who would like to feel connected to future technologies and change, global opportunities, personal development, and working in a great team. Passionate about their people and communities, the ideal individual would hold the following skills:

Significant senior experience in procurement, project or portfolio governance, corporate governance, property portfolio management or a combination of these areas, with a record of leading managers or functional capability.
Strong commercial and financial skills, including sourcing, supplier negotiation, cost and business-case analysis, investment prioritisation and benefits tracking.
Experience overseeing a project portfolio and applying governance, assurance, risk, change control, resource planning and senior reporting.
Sound understanding of supplier, contract and third-party risk management, delegated authority and internal controls.
We are proud of the “way we do things” at Sure; We work together as One Team, We strive for Customer Satisfaction, We are Reliable, We have a Passion for Technology & Learning and We are Community & Sustainability Focused, and individuals applying will “feel connected” to our Company values.

Our client seeks a proactive and detail-oriented Client Services Administrator/Senior Client Services Administrator to join their team. Work with and support the Client Services Team Leader and directors in drafting board minutes and written resolutions to approve various administration matters. Work with and supports the Client Services Team Leader to organise and prioritise various administration matters, including but not limited to the onboarding of new clients and establishment of entities / trusts, ongoing administration matters for existing structures and the closure of structures. Utilising the Office 365, Viewpoint document manager and entity administration functions, and network drive to complete tasks and keep records up-to-date. Assist the entire administration team and directors with transactions such as the purchase and sale of various assets and general day-to-day payments (online and written instructions). Key Skills & Experience: 3 - 5+ years TCSP experience ideally. A good level of understanding in the day-to-day administration of companies and trusts, including drafting of minutes, agreements, letters etc. and correspondence with clients and 3rd parties. Able to work on own initiative and as part of a team.
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16818

Applicants must have a minimum of 5 years' experience in a casino gaming role and be confident in dealing Blackjack, Roulette, Brag and Poker to a high professional standard. To apply please contact hr@palacegroup.im for an application form. If you have not heard from us within two weeks from submitting your application, please presume your application has been unsuccessful.

Build your career in New Homes Sales with Dandara!

Are you a natural people person who loves delivering great customer service? Looking for an exciting career opportunity where your personality, enthusiasm and ambition matter just as much as your experience?

At Dandara, we don't just build houses – we create beautiful homes and communities where people love to live.

We're looking for a friendly, motivated and customer-focused New Homes Sales Consultant to join our Isle of Man team, helping customers find their perfect home.

You don't need previous experience in new homes sales to join us. We're keen to hear from people with backgrounds in retail, hospitality, customer service, estate agency or other sales environments who are looking to take their next career step. This role will be based at our Douglas Sales Office.

If you're confident, approachable, organised and eager to learn, we'd love to hear from you.

What you'll be doing

As a New Homes Sales Consultant, you'll be the welcoming face of Dandara, helping customers through one of the most exciting and important purchases they'll ever make.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
Making a great first impression – welcoming prospective buyers to our developments and show homes, creating a friendly and professional experience.
Helping customers find their dream home – understanding what they're looking for, showcasing our properties and explaining the features and benefits of each home.

Building lasting relationships – supporting customers throughout their homebuying journey, from their initial enquiry through to receiving their keys.
Supporting the sales process – responding to enquiries, arranging viewings, following up with potential purchasers and helping secure reservations.
Personalising the experience – helping customers explore optional extras and upgrades to make their new home their own.
Working together – liaising with colleagues, mortgage advisers and legal representatives to ensure sales progress smoothly.
Keeping things organised – maintaining accurate customer records, updating our sales system and ensuring our show homes and sales areas always look their best.
Creating memorable moments – helping with home demonstrations and preparing for the exciting day customers collect their keys.
Learning about the local market – developing your understanding of our Isle of Man developments, available properties and the wider housing market.

What we're looking for
We're looking for someone with the right attitude, personality and potential. Previous property sales experience would be welcome, but it's certainly not essential.
Ideally, you'll have:
Experience in a customer-facing role, whether that's retail, hospitality, customer service, sales or a similar environment.
A full driving licence.
Flexibility to work weekends as part of your normal working week.

Please apply here to this role - https://careers.dandara.com/jobs/8575717-new-homes-sales-consultant

As a Commercial Plumber, you will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, testing and repair of plumbing systems within commercial buildings, including offices, schools, hospitals, and industrial facilities. The ideal candidate will have experience working with large-scale plumbing systems, ensuring compliance with Regulations such as Health and Safety and Approved Codes of Practice while delivering high-quality workmanship.

Key Responsibilities
1. Installation Work
Install and commission new plumbing systems, including water distribution, heating, sanitary ware, pipework, drainage, and plantroom equipment.
Interpret and work from technical drawings, specifications, and job instructions.
Ensure compliance with BS EN standards, the Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations, and manufacturer requirements.

2. Maintenance & Repairs
Perform reactive and planned preventative maintenance (PPM) on plumbing and/or gas systems including:
Pipework and valves
Booster sets and hot water systems
Pressurisation units
Thermostatic mixing valves (TMVs)
Diagnose and rectify faults efficiently to minimise downtime and disruption.
Inspect, test and service equipment in line with industry standards.

3. Compliance & Certification
Ensure compliance with relevant legislation including:
UK: Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations 1999, Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations 1998 (if applicable), Building Regulations Part G.
Isle of Man: Building Regulations 2014 and associated technical standards, including plumbing, water heating and drainage.
Complete documentation such as commissioning records, service reports, and compliance certificates.
Work in accordance with Legionella prevention guidance (e.g. L8/HSG274 and Isle of Man equivalents).
Gas Safe registration and Core gas qualification is desireable.

For more details and to apply contact careers@ifg.im or 01624603660.

As a Commercial Plumber, you will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, testing and repair of plumbing systems within commercial buildings, including offices, schools, hospitals, and industrial facilities. The ideal candidate will have experience working with large-scale plumbing systems, ensuring compliance with Regulations such as Health and Safety and Approved Codes of Practice while delivering high-quality workmanship.

Key Responsibilities
1. Installation Work
Install and commission new plumbing systems, including water distribution, heating, sanitary ware, pipework, drainage, and plantroom equipment.
Interpret and work from technical drawings, specifications, and job instructions.
Ensure compliance with BS EN standards, the Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations, and manufacturer requirements.

2. Maintenance & Repairs
Perform reactive and planned preventative maintenance (PPM) on plumbing and/or gas systems including:
Pipework and valves
Booster sets and hot water systems
Pressurisation units
Thermostatic mixing valves (TMVs)
Diagnose and rectify faults efficiently to minimise downtime and disruption.
Inspect, test and service equipment in line with industry standards.

3. Compliance & Certification
Ensure compliance with relevant legislation including:
UK: Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations 1999, Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations 1998 (if applicable), Building Regulations Part G.
Isle of Man: Building Regulations 2014 and associated technical standards, including plumbing, water heating and drainage.
Complete documentation such as commissioning records, service reports, and compliance certificates.
Work in accordance with Legionella prevention guidance (e.g. L8/HSG274 and Isle of Man equivalents).
Gas Safe registration and Core gas qualification is desireable.

For more details and to apply contact careers@ifg.im or 01624603660.

At Westmoreland Road Spar, we pride ourselves on being the friendly face of our local community. We are looking for a reliable, energetic, and customer-focused individual to join our dedicated team as a Shop Assistant.

As a Shop Assistant, you will be the heart of our store, ensuring our customers receive a warm welcome and excellent service. Your daily duties will involve operating the till accurately, handling cash and card transactions, stocking shelves, rotating stock, and maintaining high standards of store cleanliness and presentation. You will also assist customers with queries and uphold all health, safety, and licensing regulations.

We believe in investing in our team. Beyond your daily shop duties, you will receive structured training to become a Responsible Person for the store. This is a fantastic opportunity to develop leadership skills, take on extra responsibility, and grow within the business.

We are looking for someone with a flexible schedule who can work regular evening and weekend shifts. You should have a friendly, approachable attitude and be passionate about delivering great service. Punctuality, honesty, and the ability to work well independently as well as part of a team are essential. Previous retail experience is preferred, but not essential, as full training will be provided for the right candidate who demonstrates a strong work ethic and enthusiasm.

In return, we offer comprehensive, hands-on training from day one, opportunities for career progression and leadership development, a competitive pay rate, staff discounts, and a supportive, friendly working environment.

If you are ready for a new challenge and want to join a great local team, we would love to hear from you. Please send your CV along with a short note detailing your availability to westmorelandroad@spar.co.im

Notes
Delivering your part of our customer shopping trip by:

I ensurethe van and trays I use are clean and kept tidy/organised.
Leaving the back yard clean, tidy and clear of rubbish, and picking up litter as I see it.
Ensuring trays are washed as part of the tray wash process.
Loading the van as required, checking the van for roadworthiness.
Talking to the customer about any changes to their order, including short code item and substitutions, offering a refund for anything they are unhappy with.
Taking care of products/deliveries as if they were my own.
Explaining to the customer that they will not be charged any more for their substitutions.
Delivering during the customers time slot.
Calling the customer before arriving at their property if early.
Calling the store/centre if running 30 or more minutes late.
What you will need 
Build relationships with colleagues to create team spirit, working together to make sure our store is the best it can be for customers.
Warm and welcoming in interactions with customers and colleagues, taking time to understand the customer and say Thank you.
Acting quickly to respond to the changing needs of our customers and embracing change within my store.
Energetic and driven to deliver beyond expectations, integrating home and work to achieve a balance that is right for me.
Sharing ideas with my Manager and other colleagues on how we can improve our store for customers.
A valid UK/EU/EEA Driving licence (Full or Automatic only) for at least 12 months with no more than 3 penalty points.

Everything we do starts with the people we serve. We’re proud to be the traders behind the tradespeople: the nuts and bolts behind the job, always ready to save the day (or at least the project).

From power tools to workwear, cables to pipe fittings, we offer over 60,000 products across 900+ stores – and that’s not to mention our industry-leading digital services. Join Screwfix and be part of a team of experts who get the job done quickly, affordably, and always with a smile.

You’ll be a vital part of the team, getting stuck in and leading by example. Whether you’re front-of-house helping customers or in the warehouse keeping our standards high, customers are always at the front of your mind. And with the help of our excellent training programmes and varied shift patterns to support a healthy work life balance, you’ll be on the right track for a promising career with us!

YOU ARE…

An experienced supervisor or duty manager who is used to managing a small team in a fast-paced environment
Great at giving amazing customer service, and able to translate that into sales
Inquisitive, ever-questioning and ever-improving
Passionate about our business
Friendly, flexible, reliable, honest and like to work hard!
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Joining Screwfix means joining a growing team – full of support, opportunities, and fun!
We offer a competitive salary
28 days annual leave (including an allowance for Bank Holidays). Increasing with length of service, up to a maximum of 33 days annual leave.
Award-winning company pension scheme - up to 14% Kingfisher contribution!
Life cover
20% discount with Screwfix and B&Q
Discounted healthcare
Company share save schemes
We’ll also help you be the best you can be, with excellent training and ongoing development.
To find out more about us, please email careers@screwfix.com for any queries

Follow us and find out more on our LinkedIn, Instagram & Twitter pages

Apply now! – Upload your CV and complete your application

*Our hourly rates may include a location allowance which is reviewed annually and may change.

Our policy is to employ the best qualified people and provide equal opportunity for the advancement of employees including promotion and training and not to discriminate against any person because of gender, race, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, belief or disability.

If you require any additional support or adjustments to help you make an application, please contact us at careers@screwfix.com

Join us at Poundland during this festive period as a Seasonal Sales Assistant and help make the most magical shopping season of the year even brighter for our customers.

As one of Poundland's Elves on the shop floor, you’ll be a festive ambassador for our brand, creating a warm, welcoming, and merry shopping experience every day.

You’ll be part of a friendly and energetic team, keeping shelves stocked with all those essential items, delivering fantastic customer service, supporting deliveries, ensuring the checkouts run smoothly, and helping maintain a safe, tidy, and cheerful store environment.

We're looking for team players with a positive, can-do attitude and a friendly approach. Good organisation and attention to detail, especially when working on the tills, are essential. This role will start soon and last until the end of December, and we may require you to work different shifts based on store needs, therefore flexibility is key.

Notes
Delivering your part of our customer shopping trip by:

I ensurethe van and trays I use are clean and kept tidy/organised.
Leaving the back yard clean, tidy and clear of rubbish, and picking up litter as I see it.
Ensuring trays are washed as part of the tray wash process.
Loading the van as required, checking the van for roadworthiness.
Talking to the customer about any changes to their order, including short code item and substitutions, offering a refund for anything they are unhappy with.
Taking care of products/deliveries as if they were my own.
Explaining to the customer that they will not be charged any more for their substitutions.
Delivering during the customers time slot.
Calling the customer before arriving at their property if early.
Calling the store/centre if running 30 or more minutes late.
What you will need 
Build relationships with colleagues to create team spirit, working together to make sure our store is the best it can be for customers.
Warm and welcoming in interactions with customers and colleagues, taking time to understand the customer and say Thank you.
Acting quickly to respond to the changing needs of our customers and embracing change within my store.
Energetic and driven to deliver beyond expectations, integrating home and work to achieve a balance that is right for me.
Sharing ideas with my Manager and other colleagues on how we can improve our store for customers.
A valid UK/EU/EEA Driving licence (Full or Automatic only) for at least 12 months with no more than 3 penalty points.
